## Findings

### Anti-patterns

- God function: <module> in docs/site/chapters.js calls 539 unique functions — consider decomposing into smaller, focused functions [critical]
- This zone pairs a CLI checker (cli/check/fields.ts) with core mutation logic (mutations/derive-edits.ts, mutations/types.ts) — the checker belongs with the other cli/check/* files architecturally (same pattern as the other ~11 checkers in core), not with the mutation engine it happens to validate; its presence here is what drags cohesion down to 0.11 despite the tight core-mutations↔core coupling being otherwise a normal layered dependency (mutation engine depends on core graph/types, as expected) [warning] (core-mutations)

### Patterns

- cli/check/*.ts (arrangement, beginnings, brand, city, context, intelligence, lenses, modules, policy, relations, settings) is a flat set of ~11 single-purpose checker modules fanning out from cli/index.ts; each likely imports a narrow slice of the domain modules (app.ts, graph/, city.ts, beginning.ts, bind.ts) — this is a clean hub-and-spoke from the CLI into the domain, but bundling it into the same zone as the domain modules it checks hides that the checkers have no interface of their own beyond ad hoc imports; consider a `cli/check` barrel/interface so domain changes don't require touching each checker file's import list individually [warning] (core)
- The call graph shows this zone as almost purely passive (0 internal calls, cohesion 0) relative to core and core-mutations — it defines types/log structures that core and core-mutations call into, but has no internal logic of its own tying ops/log.ts, ops/types.ts, ops/undo.ts and who.ts together; splitting who.ts into its own zone (or folding it into core) would likely raise core-ops's cohesion score without changing any actual code boundary [warning] (core-ops)

### Relationships

- Tightly coupled modules: packages/studio/src/changes.ts and packages/studio/src/source.ts — 33 cross-file calls (unidirectional). Consider extracting shared interface or merging [info]

### Suggestions

- Zone "apps" has files across 16 directories — consider consolidating under a dedicated directory [info] (apps)
- Zone "core" has files across 14 directories — consider consolidating under a dedicated directory [info] (core)
- packages/core/src/cli/check/ contains files from 3 zones (core, core-cli, core-mutations) — consider grouping into subdirectories to clarify architectural boundaries [info]
- Hub function: launchEngine in scripts/lib/engine.mjs is called from 26 files (high fan-in expected for this module type) — changes here have wide impact, consider if responsibilities can be narrowed [info]
- Hub function: useGraview in packages/react/src/context.tsx is called from 11 files — changes here have wide impact, consider if responsibilities can be narrowed [info]
- 5 potentially unused exports in packages/pages/src/page-places.tsx have no incoming calls: PlacePicture, GalleryCard, PlaceCard, DefaultPlacesPage, DefaultPlacePage [warning]
- 4 potentially unused exports in packages/core/src/cli/check/relations.ts have no incoming calls: checkReadings, checkEdgeNamesAgree, checkActsFromEnds, checkUnmakeable [info]
